"skill click the link to access the printable version, then fill the grid using the numbers 1 through 9, ensuring each digit appears exactly once in every row, column, and 3x3 box.

When you have completed the puzzle, you can purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition to view the solved grid and compare your answer.

This activity offers a temporary mental workout, much like assessing the weight of a gas sample in a climate experiment, adding an unexpected twist to your routine.

Enjoy the challenge and remember that each number’s placement is crucial, just as balancing climate factors requires careful consideration."
